name: Portability Validation

on:
  schedule:
    # Runs daily at 2:00 AM UTC
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'qumun/**'
      - 'main.go'
      - 'Makefile'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'qumun/**'
      - 'main.go'
      - 'Makefile'

jobs:
  portability-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        kernel-version:
          - "6.12.2"
          - "6.13"
          - "6.14"
          - "6.15"
          - "6.16"
          - "6.17"
    name: Test Kernel ${{ matrix.kernel-version }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21' # Adjust based on project requirements if different

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y make gcc linux-headers-${{ matrix.kernel-version }}

      - name: Build and Test Portability
        run: |
          make test KERNEL_VERSION=${{ matrix.kernel-version }}
